segments.summary: Reviewed MA-015 through MA-020 exactly and adversarially. The requested/effective envelope and no-fallback ownership are strong, but concurrent resolver commit, mutation, dispatch, and history persistence lack atomicity and rollback semantics.

Reviewed MA-021 through MA-025 exactly and adversarially. Eligibility, cooldown, provider separation, and root ownership are explicit; clock/freshness behavior and safe transactional auth import remain underspecified.

Reviewed MA-026 through MA-031 exactly and adversarially. Provider/auth/root/sharing boundaries are coherent, but minimum auth-bearing import lacks a concrete allowlist and partial-failure security contract.

Reviewed MA-032 through MA-037 exactly and adversarially. Cross-actor consumption, Usage ownership, source labels, priority, and GUI structure are explicit; signal freshness and deterministic concurrent selection are not.
Reviewed MA-038 through MA-043 exactly and adversarially. Pooling and GUI readiness truth are detailed, but legal transitions and stale asynchronous result suppression are absent.

Reviewed MA-044 through MA-049 exactly and adversarially. Removal, auth, credential, retired-flow, and Usage boundaries are explicit; multi-system compensation, cancellation, and late-result handling remain gaps.

Reviewed MA-050 through MA-055 exactly and adversarially. Projection governance and native-auth shapes are defined, but lock/crash behavior and the authority safety of 401/403/429 cross-account retry are unresolved.

Reviewed MA-056 through MA-060 and retired MA-001 exactly and adversarially. Ownership boundaries are preserved, but async task context propagation and role-specific authority denial semantics are unspecified.
